title: TestCachePathIsPerFactoryEndpoint measures the host's HOME
description:
While reproducing the stripped-gate recipe, HOME=<empty> fails internal/factory/dashboard with 'CachePath: $HOME is not defined'. It is the same meta-class this tick ends for git — a test reading the host instead of constructing its condition — but it is outside this tick's scope (git config, git maintenance, git working directory), so the gate strips git's environment only. A t.Setenv HOME in that test would close it.
evidence: internal/factory/dashboard/snapshot_test.go:226 — env HOME= go test ./internal/factory/dashboard -run TestCachePathIsPerFactoryEndpoint
